title: When the Summit Burns
author: Astrid Nystrom
blurb: Astrid Underhill, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
